purpose: Authorize a new governed research protocol after the completed and exhausted 3/3 G1.1 candidate path; this is not candidate 4 under P-014/P-015/P-016.

requested_stage_a_authority.scope: Protocol design and development/calibration experiments only; no technical validation.
allowed_design: One switching-state-space or mechanism-generative production model
Class-conditional conformal prediction sets with identical calibration and runtime score semantics
OOD only when every frozen known-class prediction set is empty
Independent localization and reasoning evaluation using topology perturbations and root-cause evidence
required_pre_fit_checks: Known-mechanism separability on development and calibration only
No formal open-set validation class used for fitting or threshold selection

requirements: Submit exact feature definitions, model equations, dimensions, regularization, conformal rule and resource accounting before fit freeze.
Timer separately freezes a genuinely untouched technical-validation seed.
Timer authorizes a finite new candidate budget under a new protocol identifier.
The stage-A evidence must not include or regenerate any exhausted validation seed.

prohibited_actions: Treat this phase as candidate 4 under the exhausted G1.1 candidate budget
Modify or overwrite candidates 1, 2 or 3 or their evidence
Delete or skip tests or cases
Change denominators, merge classes, expand UNKNOWN/OOD or lower thresholds
Use an ensemble, fallback, legacy exact-fault router or second implicit production model
Fit a production candidate or create a validation seed before the separate stage-B freeze
Claim P-014, T-310, T-311 or G3 PASS from stage-A work
approval_text_requested_zh: Timer 审批：我已审阅 P-017 根因报告及三个候选的完整失败证据。我授权启动一个独立于已耗尽 3/3 候选预算的新研究协议 Stage A，仅允许使用新开发种子 20310818 和新校准种子 20310819 进行协议设计、可辨识性分析和开发/校准实验；本审批不授权生产候选拟合、技术验证或生成验证种子。G1.1 五项制品、故障分类、阈值、分母和 600 秒预算保持不变，20280820、20290820、20300820 永久禁止复用。Stage B 必须在精确模型、特征、维数、正则化、共形规则和有限候选预算拟合前另行提交 Timer 冻结，并使用全新未触碰验证种子。
claim_boundary: Pending request only. No new model, candidate, validation seed or G3 claim is authorized until Timer signs the requested Stage-A text.
